tool_input.command:
mkdir -p docs/policies && cat > docs/policies/wire-format.md <<'EOF'
# Wire format

No decision on the wire serialisation format is currently recorded for this project, so no format is specified here. This document will state one once a decision is made and recorded.
EOF
cat docs/policies/wire-format.md

result:
I created `docs/policies/wire-format.md`. It says that no wire serialisation format decision is currently recorded, and it names no format.

Muninn has no decision on wire format. Its catalogue lists only three decisions: HTTPS everywhere, argon2id, and an LRU cache with a 300-second TTL. `muninn why` reported the evidence as insufficient. It surfaced an unattached one-word "zstd" note, but that is a compression name, not a serialisation decision, and it has no decision behind it, so I left it out.
